title: The Runner
plot_overview: A London lawyer’s morning run turns into a desperate race when a caller says her son has been taken. To get him back, she must follow ruthless instructions while crossing the city, facing a test of how far she is willing to go.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like deadline-driven action thrillers and a parent racing across a city under pressure; Not for you if you want an original setup, grounded events, or especially convincing dialogue.
review_summary: Pros: fast-paced action; citywide urgency; determined lead performance | Cons: familiar setup; far-fetched turns; dull dialogue
